scientific_integrity: Exact polynomial and spectral identities proved; infinite limit follows from a binomial local limit estimate with explicit endpoint domination. Finite verifier corroborates but does not replace the proof. Some recent related full texts were inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Counts primitive two-cycles already periodic; excludes attraction basins, all other periodic orbit families and unbalanced asymptotic limits. Plausible historical equivalent in bipartite random mapping literature not fully ruled out.
title: Arcsine firing fractions and exact two-cycle mass census on complete bipartite sandpiles
